name: mcsh-visual
description: Visual-editor for dirMcsh Mcs*/Hitp*.last.html files. Renders the live local-server page, lets you edit the whole page, and on Save re-serializes the WHOLE document to the canonical 2/4-space Mcsh format.

commands.title: Open in Mcsh-visual-manager
Open McsHitp file by code
Open McsHitp file by code only (no visual)
Make current-sect-concept McshFile-concept
insert-para-description-and-name: before the cursor line, the description:: and name:: of its section
insert-sect-tree-gen-spe: before the cursor line, the GENERIC-SPECIFIC-TREE section of its concept
insert-sect-tree-whole-part: before the cursor line, the WHOLE-PART-TREE section of its concept
insert-sect-tree-parent-child: before the cursor line, the PARENT-CHILD-TREE section of its concept
inheritance-renumber: the numbered attribute of the cursor gets another number, the others shift, its specifics follow
inheritance-generalize: the attribute of the cursor is copied to a generic as NN_x of G
inheritance-show-inherited: the attributes the concept of the cursor inherits
validate-concept: the concept of the cursor or URL bar (or another), report, or fix unambiguous inside it and report
validate-concept-with-rule: the concept of the cursor or URL bar (or another), report, or fix inside it and report, one rule
validate-file: a file (the current one prefilled), report, or fix unambiguous and report
validate-file-with-rule: a file (the current one prefilled), report, or fix and report, one rule
validate-directory: a directory (the current one, or chosen), every rule: report, or fix unambiguous and report
validate-directory-with-rule: report, or fix and report, one rule, a directory
validate-worldview: a worldview (the current one prefilled), every rule: report, or fix unambiguous and report
validate-worldview-with-rule: a worldview (the current one prefilled), report, or fix and report, one rule, the whole worldview
validate-list: the files and dirs of dirManager/validate.txt, every rule: report, or fix unambiguous and report
validate-list-with-rule: report, or fix and report, one rule, the files and dirs of dirManager/validate.txt

mcshv.serverOrigin.description: Origin of the local web server that renders the pages (e.g. http://localhost).

mcshv.docRootFolder.description: Folder name in the file path that marks the server document-root. The URL path is everything after it. Defaults to 'dirNodews' to match server.mjs (web root = C:\dirNodews).

mcshv.keybindingsPath.description: Path to your VS Code keybindings.json. The viewer auto-syncs its wrap/insert chord shortcuts from it. Leave empty to use the default per-OS user path.
